content.title: Masimo’s (NASDAQ:MASI) Q3 Sales Top Estimates
content.summary: Medical tech company Masimo (NASDAQ:MASI) reported Q3 CY2025 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 8.2% year on year to $371.5 million. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $1.52 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.32 per share was 9.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
